article.title: How to eat well anywhere in Mexico
article.excerpt: You'll sometimes hear fallacious claims that San Miguel Allende or Guanajuato or other parts of Mexico don't have superb food. What is true, in many Mexican cities, is that almost every place near the main square is only so-so. Here's what to do: 1. Look for time-specific food.
